entities.name: Mimeoplasm
entities.description: Legendary ooze of Muraganda that absorbs the power and traits of the dead and carries the ancestral memory of Saurid leaders.

entities.name: Saurids
entities.description: Saurid warriors of the south who follow and worship the Mimeoplasm.

entities.name: Scar witches
entities.description: Witches who see the Mimeoplasm as the ultimate enemy of the world.

events.summary: Saurids feed their great leaders to the Mimeoplasm upon death and build temples across its path.
events.quote: The saurids revere it, feeding it their great leaders upon their deaths

relations.quote: The Mimeoplasm is always followed in its roaming by the Saurid warriors of the south

relations.note: see it as the ultimate enemy
relations.quote: seeing it as the ultimate enemy of the world
The Mimeoplasm is a legendary ooze from Muraganda .
